what: On first open, a notice text (school · brand name) on a background-color cover turns on over 1s power3.inOut and turns off over 2s expo.out. Meanwhile the hero pieces turn on from transparent at their own set times (title 1.2s · heading 1.5s · image 1.7s 3s power3.out · cloud 1.9s 2s power2.inOut), and at 1.9s the cover is released and scrolling is unlocked (fx:open). The cover doesn’t lift away — the screen fades up overlapping as the text turns off

options.inease · outease: Notice text curve, default power3.inOut · expo.out
options.release: When the curtain is lifted and fx:open fires (seconds), default 1.9 — shorten it for screens opened often, like apps
options.lock: If true, locks document scroll while the curtain is up (the original pins the body in place)
options.[data-fx-part=cover]: (If any) Background color overlay — hidden on release
options.[data-fx-part=note]: (if present) notice text above the curtain
options.[data-fx-part=cue]: Pieces that turn on in turn — data-at (seconds, default 1.2 + order×.3) · data-dur (seconds, default 2) · data-ease (default expo.out)
options.fx:open · fx:done: Event the element emits when the curtain is lifted and when all pieces are lit — attach scroll effects after fx:done

note: Above 1100px the original runs title (1.2s) then lead text (1.5s), below that lead text then title — data-at is changed per width
